Where to catch Hypno

Drowzee evolves into Hypno starting at level 26..

Not in the wild. Hypno cannot be caught in the wild in FireRed/LeafGreen — you only get it through evolution: Drowzee evolves into Hypno starting at level 26.

Our take: Yes. Hypno has high special defense and Psychic is strong in Kanto — a reliable special tank available early on Route 11 (as Drowzee).
